subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 1/4] exportfs/mountd/exportd: track the svc_export policy highest attribute

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch updates the exportfs and mountd modules to track the highest attribute in the kernel's svc_export netlink policy, which is stored in a new field called max_attr within the nfsd_export_policy structure. This change is necessary to avoid sending attributes that an older kernel would reject, allowing for more flexible and backwards-compatible configuration of NFS exports. The patch modifies two files: export_policy.c and include/exportfs.h, adding new fields and updating existing code to handle the max_attr field correctly.
